Summary: Checking if the Capture Facility Tool works for Capture Files.
Preconditions: Have two instances of ASE2000 in Task Mode - Master and Slave configured for DNP3 LAN/WAN Protocol.

1. In the 'View or Select Capture directory' drop-down -> Database -> Create a new row by entering a name for your Capture file. Press 'OK'.
2. Start the RTU, connect the Master.
3. Click on the Start Capture button.

5. Click on the Stop Capture button.

The Task List must be emptied.

Summary: To check Freeze Counters with Acknowledgement
Preconditions: Have two instances of ASE2000 (Master and RTU) Iin Task Mode, configured for DNP3 LAN/WAN with a few Frozen Counters, Binary Counters, Digital Output Status points, Analog Output Status points, running and connected.
Actions:
1. Send Once: Link Status and Reset Link
2. Send Once: Class Poll
3. Send Once: Freeze Counters with No Acknowledgement set to False
Expected Results:
1. A Freeze Request must go with Function 7 (Immeadiate Freeze), Object 20 (Binary Counter)
2. A Freeze Response must be received with Function 129 (Response)
3. A Frozen Counter Request must be sent with Function 1 (read), Object 21 (Frozen Counter)
4. A Frozen Counter Response must be recieved with Function 129 (response), Object 21 (Frozen Counter). It must have the configured PI points.

Summary: To check Freeze Counters with Acknowledgement SAv2.
Preconditions:
Have two instances of ASE2000 (Master and RTU) Iin Task Mode, configured for DNP3 LAN/WAN with a few Frozen Counters, Binary Counters, Digital Output Status points, Analog Output Status points, running and connected.
Configure Secure Authentication V2 in tools properties.Also set "opt.critical functions" options.
Actions:
1. Send Once: Link Status and Reset Link
2. Send Once: Class Poll
3. Send Once: Freeze Counters with No Acknowledgement set to False
Expected Results:
1. A Freeze Request must go with Function 7 (Immeadiate Freeze), Object 20 (Binary Counter).
2. Authentication challenge response and authentication reply request messgaes will be displayed.
3. A Freeze Response must be received with Function 129 (Response)
4. A Frozen Counter Request must be sent with Function 1 (read), Object 21 (Frozen Counter)
5. A Frozen Counter Response must be recieved with Function 129 (response), Object 21 (Frozen Counter). It must have the configured PI points.

Summary: To check Freeze Counters without Acknowledgement
Preconditions: Have two instances of ASE2000 (Master and RTU) Iin Task Mode, configured for DNP3 LAN/WAN with a few Frozen Counters, Binary Counters, Digital Output Status points, Analog Output Status points, running and connected.
Actions:
1. Send Once: Link Status and Reset Link
2. Send Once: Class Poll
3. Send Once: Freeze Counters with No Acknowledgement set to True
Expected Results:
1. A Freeze Request must go with Function 8 (Immeadiate Freeze (No Ack)), Object 20 (Binary Counter). The name of the message must be 'Freeze (All)'.

Summary:
Request and response format in case of SunSpec Modbus Serial
Proper request and response frames should be send and received for the SunSpec Modbus Serial Protocol
Preconditions: SunSpec Modbus Simulator executable with serial configuration should be running in the system
Actions:
1. Open ASE2000 application in exchange mode with the protocol selected as SunSpec Modbus Serial.
2. Do the SunSpec Modbus Serial configuration matching to the server.
3. Configure RML exchange with device id as 1 and use Send Once button to issue that exchange.
4. Monitor the request and response frames.
Expected Results:
1. Ensure that the request sent from ASE2000 matches the one received by the simulator in terms of Device ID, function code, message and CRC.
2. Ensure that the response sent from the simulator is received accurately in ASE2000, with correct function code, byte count, data values and CRC.
Remarks: For read function code will be always 3.

Summary:
SunS' Header response
The first request sent from ASE2000 using SunSpec Modbus Serial should receive "SunS" as the response data
Preconditions: SunSpec Modbus Simulator executable with serial configuration should be running in the system
Actions: 1. Send RML Once.
Expected Results:
1. Ensure that the first response is "SunS" header and no data model is read if this is not received.
Remarks: In ASCII: 0x53 = 'S', 0x75 = 'u', 0x6E = 'n', 0x53 = 'S'. 21365 = Su 28243 = nS

Summary: For DNP3 LAN/WAN, DNP3 Serial, Operate Relay, SBO Relay and Direct Operate Relay, check if Output Point Mapping is working as it should.
Preconditions:
1. Open two instances of ASE2000 in Exchange mode (one master and one RTU).
2. Select DNP3 LAN/WAN or DNP3 Serial protocol.
3. Configure Digital Points with Point IDs in RTU.
4. In the Description field of the Point List of a particular point map it to a digital point.
eg: For Digital-to-Digital mapping - In the Description of DI 2, if you put "[1]", then if you send an operate command to point ID 1 its output will be mapped to DI 2 value.
For Digital-to-Analog mapping - In the Description of AI 2, if you put "[DOAI:2:2]", then if you send an operate command to point ID 2, its value will be used to increment/decrement the analog value by times 2.
Actions:
1. Issue Link status and Reset link commands.
2. Issue Operate Relay, SBO Relay or Direct Operate Relay command after configuring it properly by setting a value and assigning proper point index value which is existing in the configured points.
Expected Results: The value corresponding to the Operate command should be reflected to the respective Digital Input point where it is mapped to.

After sending once:

1. Open SunSpec Modbus Simulator exe containing folder in command prompt and use command, modKSim.exe -p 8081 -d 1 to run application. Open a browser and enter "http://localhost:8081/modbus/login" to view UI of simulator. In login page configure Modbus RTU, COM as COM6 and click Submit.
2. Open ASE2000 application in exchange mode with protocol selected as "SunSpec Modbus Serial". In Tools => Properties => SunSpec Modbus Serial tab, To Master COM as None.
3. Open exchange properties of RML and RMPL exchange, provide device id as 1. Click Ok. Use Send once button to issue RML exchange then RMPL exchange.
4. Open exchange properties of RMP exchange, select the required model and required datapoints. Check the transmit flag. Click Ok. Use Start button to transmit that exchange.
5. Monitor the request and response.
Expected Results:
1. Verify that each datapoint in exchange object in the ASE2000 simulator is read from SunSpec simulator and its value is displayed in object properties.
2. Verify that the exchange continue to transmit after reaching last object in the object list in the specified frequency

Summary: When Scale Factor is enabled, the entered value in the Object Properties must be scaled value, and validation must be performed on the corresponding unscaled value.

Actions:

2. Navigate to Tools ? Properties ? Protocol Specific tab and enable the Scale Factor for Write or Both (Read and Write).
3. Issue RML and RMPL exchange,
4. Enter a scaled value, that is, a valid value within Int32 range multiplied by scale factor multiplier (e.g., if unscaled = 2 and SF=100, enter 200) - for the data point Active Power Set Point (W) in Model 704 in the WDP exchange.
5. Click Enter or OK button
Expected Results: 1. Verify that application accepts scaled value input only if if the unscaled equivalent is valid and within the range.

Summary: When Scale Factor is enabled, entering a scaled value whose unscaled equivalent is out of range must be reverted to previous value
Preconditions: SunSpec modbus TCP/Serial server Simulator must be running.
Actions:
